item.title: Whiskers 0.8.59
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.59

### Dictation Reliability

  • Improved live cloud dictation so slower session startup is less likely to force an unnecessary full-session fallback
  • Improved audio capture handling during Bluetooth jitter and queue pressure so longer dictation sessions stay more dependable

    • ### Recovery & Setup

  • Improved model, permission, and onboarding recovery paths so setup issues are easier to recover from when something goes wrong
  • Improved cloud transcription and update checks so configuration and release problems are easier for Whiskers to detect

    • ### Improvements

  • Added clearer internal diagnostics for network trust, licensing, settings deep links, and transcription paths to make support and troubleshooting more reliable
